source_documents.title: Customized Tuning of Aggregation-Induced Emission of a Napthalimide Dye by Surfactants and Cyclodextrin

reference_evidence_units.quote: In water the dye has an emission maximum around 486 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aqueous dye, 10 micromolar; surfactant titrations at near-neutral pH.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The aqueous aggregate emission is near 486 nm. CTAB addition produces a longer-wavelength band near 600 nm above the micellar regime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The spectral change is observed; assignment to monomers and aggregates requires the source comparisons below.

reference_evidence_units.quote: A clear isoemissive point at 554 nm shows a clear transformation
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu with CTAB
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors interpret the isoemissive point and opposite changes in the two bands as aggregate-to-monomer conversion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: An isoemissive point is consistent with conversion but does not independently prove aggregate geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: rotational correlation time increases to 0.85 ns
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu in CTAB micelles
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Time-resolved anisotropy under CTAB micellar conditions.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The micelle-associated dye has a reported rotational correlation time of 0.85 ns.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Whole-body rotational reorientation is not direct measurement of an intramolecular torsional barrier.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Here we required more than 4 mM of Tween-20 to complete the deaggregation process
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu with Tween-20
reference_evidence_units.statement: Complete deaggregation requires more than 4 mM Tween-20, substantially above the stated approximately 0.06 mM CMC.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not infer that the dye's transition locates the CMC equally well for every surfactant.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This can be explained by the presence of high dipole moment of DMN-Bu due to an intramolecular charge transfer nature of the dye.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu in surfactant environments
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of monomer emission and lifetime in ionic and nonionic micelles.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors invoke the dye's ICT character to explain sensitivity to the polarity of different micellar environments.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is an ICT interpretation, not a demonstrated twisted CT geometry or an independent electron-transfer reaction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Since the aggregates are blue shifted with respect to the monomers in the case of both ionic as well as non-ionic surfactants, we confirm the existence of H-aggregates of DMN-Bu molecules in water.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Excitation spectra before and after surfactant-induced deaggregation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns aqueous dye aggregates as H-aggregates from their blue-shifted spectra relative to monomers.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A source-supported spectral assignment, not crystal-resolved packing or definitive exciton geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: cyclodextrin is too small to accommodate any napthalimide dye, but it has a good affinity towards SDS.
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-cyclodextrin, SDS and DMN-Bu
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Alpha-cyclodextrin is added to the previously deaggregated dye-SDS solution.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The proposed host-guest step captures SDS rather than inserting DMN-Bu into the cyclodextrin cavity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Host binding is system-mediated and involves a different guest. This must not become a direct dye-inclusion claim.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission maxima at 620 nm start to decrease
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu in SDS with added alpha-cyclodextrin
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Titration with alpha-cyclodextrin; changes begin near 2 mM.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The 620 nm band decreases and a band near 470 nm grows; the source also reports a 13 nm blue shift of excitation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Consistent with restored dye aggregation through micelle disruption, not proof of direct dye-host inclusion.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Plot of the fluorescence intensity of 10 μM DMN-Bu with varying concentration
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMN-Bu with alpha-cyclodextrin alone
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Embedded SI Fig. S6, water without SDS; 0, 2, 6 and 10.8 mM alpha-cyclodextrin.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The plotted spectra retain a similar shape and show a modest intensity decrease rather than the large spectral conversion seen with SDS present.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure visually inspected. The effect is small relative to the SDS-mediated conversion, not literally zero; no digitized intensity or binding constant is inferred.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Micellar environments change dye aggregation and rotational mobility. This enabling environmental effect overlaps with the aggregate mechanism and is not independent proof of internal RIM.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source proposes alpha-cyclodextrin binding SDS, indirectly restoring dye aggregates. This system-level label is provisional under the existing broad family definition; it does not denote direct DMN-Bu inclusion.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the source's ICT interpretation of environment-dependent monomer photophysics, without promoting it to verified TICT.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The central source explanation is reversible conversion of H-aggregates and monomers. The H assignment is spectroscopic.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of internal motion is established in the selected evidence. Whole-molecule reorientation or aggregation alone is insufficient.
